serverInfo.name: XON_MCP
serverInfo.title: XposedOrNot Breach Intelligence
serverInfo.description: Real-time data-breach lookup and analytics for emails and domains.

tools.name: check_email_breaches
tools.title: Check Email for Breaches
tools.description: Check whether an email address appears in the XposedOrNot index of known public data breaches. Returns the list of breach names only. Never returns passwords.

tools.name: get_breach_analytics
tools.title: Get Email Breach Analytics
tools.description: Get detailed breach analytics for an email address: risk score, breach timeline, exposed data categories, and password risk.

tools.name: list_breaches
tools.title: List Indexed Breaches
tools.description: List or filter indexed breaches by domain or breach ID. Accepts an optional limit (default 25, maximum 100). The full exposure description is returned only for a single breach_id lookup; filtered and unfiltered lists return compact fields.

tools.name: domain_breach_summary
tools.title: Summarize Domain Breach Exposure
tools.description: Get an aggregate breach summary for a domain, including the number of breaches, affected email accounts, pastes, and the most recent breach date. Returns only counts, not individual email addresses.

tools.name: get_breach_metrics
tools.title: Get Breach Index Metrics
tools.description: Get system-wide breach statistics: total breaches and records indexed, breaches per year and industry, the largest and most recent breaches, and when the latest breach was added.

tools.name: get_recent_breaches
tools.title: Get Recent Breaches
tools.description: Get the latest data breach news and recently added breaches tracked by XposedOrNot.
